feature: Alleato Brain Business Area document authorization

flows.name: Business Area document principal transition
steps: Apply the restrictive Business Area document policy
Exercise open-branch CRUD and Finance denial as an internal nonmember
Prove inactive Finance membership denial, then activate it and exercise Finance CRUD
Make membership inactive and independently exercise app-admin Finance CRUD
Change the same identity to an external contact
Exercise Business Area denial and unscoped legacy CRUD
flows.expectedOutcome: Every Business Area operation enforces internal and restricted-area authorization while unscoped legacy behavior remains unchanged

claims.description: An internal nonmember completes open-branch CRUD and is denied Finance read, insert, re-scope, and delete.
The same identity is denied Business Area read, insert, update, and delete after becoming external.
Inactive Finance membership remains denied and active membership enables Finance read, insert, update, and delete.
App-admin status independently enables Finance read, insert, update, and delete while membership is inactive.
Unscoped legacy read, insert, update, and delete behavior remains unchanged.
